item.text: The scan command loads the config file after flag parsing, so a directly bound CLI bool could be overwritten by the file. I’m accounting for explicit CLI presence when applying the new option, and the filter will preserve the core package while removing inactive plugin/theme entries before API requests.

The implementation is in place: configuration supports the JSON field, the scan CLI registers the flag and preserves an explicitly supplied value over file loading, and WordPress enrichment filters inactive packages before querying themes/plugins. The targeted Go tests are still compiling/running.
